EmailTemplate.name: Quote Rejected
EmailTemplate.subject: Quote Not Approved
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi Team,
After reviewing the quote - {!Quote.Name}, we've decided not to move forward with approval at this time.
{!Quote.Link}
While the proposal had its merits (and gave our budget a good cardio workout), it doesn’t align with our current scope, priorities, or cost expectations.
Thank you to everyone who reviewed and provided feedback - much appreciated. If there are alternatives worth exploring or adjustments we can suggest back to the vendor, happy to discuss.
Let’s regroup as needed to determine the best path forward.
